items.title: GameStop CEO Cohen Buys $20 Million in Stock. Wall Street Doesn’t Blink.
items.summary: GameStop  CEO Ryan Cohen dropped another $20 million of his own cash on the company’s stock, but Wall Street barely blinked.  A filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission shows Cohen purchased 1 million shares at prices ranging from $20.02 to $20.47 on Thursday.  The purchase brings Cohen’s direct holdings to 39.3 million shares, representing 7.8% of GameStop’s 504.5 million shares outstanding.
